{
  "name": "whatsapp-finance-bot",
  "version": "3.0.0",
  "description": "Um bot de WhatsApp para controle financeiro com Google Sheets e Gemini.",
  "main": "index.js",
  "scripts": {
    "start": "node index.js",
    "dev": "nodemon index.js",
    "test:state-store-security": "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/userStateSnapshotSecurity.test.js",
    "test:codex-usage-calibration": "node --test tests/codexTelemetryCollector.test.js",
    "test": "npm run test:release",
    "test:release": "node scripts/runExhaustiveLocalTestCoverage.js",
    "check:env-contract": "node scripts/checkRuntimeEnvContract.js",
    "pretest:unit": "npm run test:state-store-security && npm run test:phase6a && npm run test:phase6b && npm run test:phase6c && npm run test:phase6d && npm run test:phase6e && npm run test:legacy-telemetry",
    "test:unit": "node --test tests/unit.test.js tests/userLifecycle.test.js tests/financialStateMachine.test.js tests/onboardingState.test.js tests/financialExplainability.test.js tests/dashboardApiContracts.test.js tests/dashboardV2SummaryService.test.js tests/phase4ExitGate.test.js tests/phase5ExitGate.test.js tests/projectedPlansContract.test.js tests/projectedPlansStore.test.js tests/projectedPlanWrites.test.js tests/projectedPlansParityReport.test.js tests/projectedPlansSchedule.test.js tests/projectedPlansQueryIntegration.test.js tests/dashboardAuthSecurity.test.js tests/legacyUsageTelemetry.test.js tests/dashboardAdoptionReport.test.js tests/cardSheetUsageTelemetry.test.js tests/cardSheetUsageReport.test.js tests/cardSheetParityReport.test.js tests/legacyRetirementPolicy.test.js tests/openFinanceSandboxStaging.test.js tests/googleOAuthService.test.js tests/googleSharedMembershipRevocation.test.js tests/oauthRoutes.test.js tests/userSpreadsheetService.test.js tests/resetSpreadsheetSafety.test.js tests/readModelSqlite.test.js tests/schedulerJobs.test.js tests/rateLimiter.test.js tests/statementImportService.test.js tests/whatsapp-real-e2e-config.test.js tests/whatsapp-web-driver.test.js tests/whatsappUnreadBackfillService.test.js tests/whatsappReadyRescueService.test.js tests/whatsappLivenessService.test.js tests/runtimeHealthService.test.js tests/supervisorExitService.test.js tests/whatsappServiceLiveness.test.js tests/financialQueryAcceptanceRunner.test.js tests/analyticalLegacyReductionGate.test.js tests/financialAgent.test.js tests/financialAgentAcceptanceRunner.test.js tests/financialAgentMigrationGapRunner.test.js tests/financialAgentNovelPlannerRunner.test.js tests/familyModeService.test.js tests/geminiModelBenchmark.test.js tests/interpretationReliability.test.js tests/acceleratedEnforceGate.test.js tests/audioHandlerPrivacy.test.js tests/geminiAudioTranscription.test.js tests/dailyOpsCheckService.test.js tests/financialCommandPlanContract.test.js tests/financialCommandPlanner.test.js tests/financialCommandPlannerRunner.test.js tests/financialCommandContextTools.test.js tests/financialCommandPlannerShadow.test.js tests/financialCommandPlannerRuntimeConfig.test.js tests/financialCommandPlannerAcceleratedGate.test.js tests/canonicalLedgerProjector.test.js tests/canonicalInstallmentSchedule.test.js tests/canonicalInstallmentParity.test.js tests/canonicalLedgerForecast.test.js tests/canonicalLedgerParityReport.test.js tests/canonicalLedgerShadowStore.test.js tests/categoryBudget.test.js tests/canonicalLedgerRolloutPolicy.test.js tests/canonicalLedgerReceiptProjector.test.js tests/canonicalLedgerCanaryRouter.test.js tests/dataQualityService.test.js tests/canonicalLedgerDataQualityReader.test.js",
    "test:legacy-telemetry": "node --test tests/legacyUsageTelemetry.test.js tests/legacyEntrypointTripwire.test.js tests/legacyEntrypointAudit.test.js tests/legacyRetirementPolicy.test.js tests/legacyTripwireObservationReport.test.js tests/legacyTripwireControlledProbe.test.js tests/applyRuntimeEnvOverrides.test.js",
    "audit:legacy-entrypoints": "node scripts/runLegacyEntrypointAudit.js",
    "audit:final-closures": "node scripts/runFinalAuditClosureMatrix.js",
    "report:legacy-tripwires": "node -r dotenv/config scripts/reportLegacyTripwireObservation.js",
    "probe:legacy-tripwire": "node -r dotenv/config scripts/runLegacyTripwireControlledProbe.js --confirm-controlled-probe",
    "test:card-sheet-telemetry": "node --test tests/cardSheetUsageTelemetry.test.js",
    "test:card-sheet-report": "node --test tests/cardSheetUsageReport.test.js",
    "test:card-sheet-parity": "node --test tests/cardSheetParityReport.test.js",
    "report:dashboard-adoption": "node scripts/reportDashboardAdoption.js",
    "report:card-sheet-usage": "node scripts/reportCardSheetUsage.js",
    "report:card-sheet-parity": "node scripts/reportCardSheetParity.js",
    "report:legacy-retirement": "node scripts/reportLegacyRetirementReadiness.js",
    "test:open-finance-sandbox": "node --test tests/openFinanceSandboxStaging.test.js",
    "e2e:open-finance-sandbox": "node scripts/runPluggySandboxStagingE2E.js",
    "test:open-finance-webhook": "node --test tests/openFinanceSandboxWebhook.test.js",
    "e2e:open-finance-webhook": "node scripts/runPluggySandboxWebhookE2E.js",
    "test:open-finance-inbox": "node --test tests/openFinanceSandboxWebhookInbox.test.js",
    "e2e:open-finance-inbox": "node scripts/runPluggySandboxWebhookInboxE2E.js",
    "test:open-finance-polling": "node --test tests/openFinanceSandboxPolling.test.js",
    "e2e:open-finance-polling": "node scripts/runPluggySandboxPollingE2E.js",
    "test:open-finance-live": "node --test tests/openFinancePluggyReadOnly.test.js",
    "probe:open-finance-live-staging": "node scripts/runPluggyLiveStagingProbe.js --confirm-live-read",
    "test:open-finance-historical-rx": "node --test tests/openFinanceHistoricalRx.test.js",
    "preview:open-finance-historical-rx": "node scripts/runOpenFinanceHistoricalRx.js --confirm-read-only",
    "review:open-finance-historical-local": "node scripts/runOpenFinanceHistoricalLocalReview.js",
    "check:open-finance-auto-sync": "node scripts/checkPluggyAutoSyncStatus.js",
    "preview:open-finance-shadow": "node scripts/runOpenFinanceShadowPreview.js --confirm-shadow-read",
    "preview:open-finance-lifecycle": "node scripts/runOpenFinanceLifecycleShadow.js --confirm-shadow-read",
    "preview:open-finance-outbox": "node scripts/runOpenFinanceOutboxDryRun.js --confirm-no-send",
    "check:open-finance-rollout": "node -r dotenv/config scripts/runOpenFinanceRolloutReadiness.js --confirm-no-runtime-change",
    "report:open-finance-outbox": "node -r dotenv/config scripts/reportOpenFinanceOutboxStats.js",
    "report:open-finance-unconfirmed": "node -r dotenv/config scripts/reportOpenFinanceUnconfirmed.js",
    "ack:open-finance-alert-delivery": "node scripts/acknowledgeOpenFinanceAlertDelivery.js",
    "ops:apply-runtime-env": "node scripts/applyRuntimeEnvOverrides.js",
    "gate:open-finance-operational-backup": "node scripts/runOpenFinanceOperationalBackupGate.js --confirm-encrypted-state-read --confirm-isolated-restore",
    "gate:open-finance-numeric-save-release": "node scripts/runOpenFinanceNumericSaveReleaseGate.js --confirm-local-copy --confirm-quiescent-source-copy --confirm-no-external-effects",
    "release:oci:build": "node scripts/release/ociArtifactRelease.js build",
    "release:oci:verify": "node scripts/release/ociArtifactRelease.js verify",
    "release:oci:prepare": "node scripts/release/ociArtifactRelease.js prepare",
    "release:oci:plan": "node scripts/release/ociArtifactRelease.js plan",
    "test:oci-release": "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/ociArtifactRelease.test.js",
    "release:open-finance:plan": "node scripts/release/openFinanceActivationRelease.js plan",
    "release:open-finance:apply": "node scripts/release/openFinanceActivationRelease.js apply",
    "test:open-finance-activation-release": "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/openFinanceActivationRelease.test.js",
    "e2e:card-read-model-unified-first": "node scripts/runCardReadModelUnifiedFirstE2E.js",
    "e2e:card-scheduler-unified-first": "node scripts/runCardSchedulerUnifiedFirstE2E.js",
    "e2e:card-user-id-validation-unified-first": "node scripts/runCardUserIdValidationUnifiedFirstE2E.js",
    "test:plans": "node --test tests/projectedPlansContract.test.js tests/projectedPlansStore.test.js tests/projectedPlanWrites.test.js tests/projectedPlansParityReport.test.js tests/projectedPlansSchedule.test.js tests/projectedPlansQueryIntegration.test.js",
    "test:phase5-exit": "node --test tests/phase5ExitGate.test.js",
    "test:phase6a": "node --test tests/financialBatchMaintenance.test.js tests/batchMaintenanceHandler.test.js",
    "test:phase6b": "node --test tests/statementImportService.test.js tests/financialExportService.test.js tests/financialExportHandler.test.js",
    "test:phase6c": "node --test tests/financialReceiptService.test.js tests/financialReceiptHandler.test.js",
    "test:phase6d": "node --test tests/documentOcrImportService.test.js",
    "test:phase6e": "node --test tests/financialUndoService.test.js",
    "financial:undo-e2e": "node scripts/runFinancialUndoE2E.js",
    "financial:undo-canary": "node scripts/configureFinancialUndoCanary.js",
    "financial:document-ocr-e2e": "node scripts/runDocumentOcrE2E.js",
    "financial:document-ocr-canary": "node scripts/configureDocumentOcrCanary.js",
    "financial:receipts-e2e": "node scripts/runFinancialReceiptsE2E.js",
    "financial:receipts-canary": "node scripts/configureFinancialReceiptsCanary.js",
    "financial:file-io-e2e": "node scripts/runFinancialFileIoE2E.js",
    "financial:file-io-canary": "node scripts/configureFinancialFileIoCanary.js",
    "maintenance:batch-e2e": "node scripts/runBatchMaintenanceE2E.js",
    "maintenance:batch-canary": "node scripts/configureBatchMaintenanceCanary.js",
    "ledger:dry-run": "node scripts/runCanonicalLedgerDryRun.js",
    "plans:read-gate": "node scripts/runProjectedPlansReadOnlyGate.js --confirm-real-read",
    "plans:writes-canary": "node scripts/configureProjectedPlanWritesCanary.js",
    "plans:writes-e2e": "node scripts/runProjectedPlanWritesE2E.js",
    "ledger:installments-read-smoke": "node scripts/runCanonicalInstallmentReadSmoke.js",
    "ledger:accounts-gate": "node scripts/runCanonicalLedgerAccountsCanaryGate.js",
    "ledger:accounts-source-gate": "node scripts/runCanonicalLedgerAccountsSourceGate.js",
    "ledger:account-movements-gate": "node scripts/runCanonicalLedgerAccountMovementsGate.js",
    "ledger:refunds-gate": "node scripts/runCanonicalLedgerRefundsGate.js",
    "test:financial-agent": "node scripts/runFinancialAgentAcceptanceBattery.js",
    "test:financial-semantic-facade": "node --test tests/financialSemanticReadFacade.test.js",
    "test:financial-iterative-shadow": "node --test tests/financialIterativeShadowAgent.test.js",
    "test:financial-evidence-adequacy": "node --test tests/financialEvidenceAdequacyVerifier.test.js",
    "report:financial-iterative-canary": "node scripts/reportFinancialIterativeCanary.js",
    "test:financial-agent:trajectory-baseline": "node scripts/runFinancialAgentTrajectoryBaseline.js",
    "test:financial-agent:golden-baseline": "node scripts/runFinancialAgentGoldenBaseline.js",
    "test:financial-agent:migration-gaps": "node scripts/runFinancialAgentMigrationGapBattery.js",
    "test:financial-agent:novel": "node scripts/runFinancialAgentNovelPlannerBattery.js",
    "test:financial-command-planner": "node scripts/runFinancialCommandPlannerBattery.js",
    "benchmark:gemini": "node scripts/runGeminiModelBenchmark.js",
    "test:interpretation-reliability": "node scripts/runInterpretationReliabilityAcceptanceBattery.js",
    "report:interpretation-readiness": "node scripts/reportInterpretationEnforceReadiness.js",
    "gate:enforce:accelerated": "node scripts/runAcceleratedEnforceGate.js",
    "gate:analytical-legacy": "node scripts/runAnalyticalLegacyReductionGate.js",
    "test:functional": "node scripts/runFunctionalTest.js",
    "test:whatsapp:e2e": "node scripts/runWhatsappRealE2E.js",
    "test:whatsapp:e2e:setup": "node scripts/setupWhatsappRealE2E.js",
    "test:whatsapp:e2e:check": "node scripts/checkWhatsappRealE2E.js",
    "test:whatsapp:e2e:invite": "node scripts/runWhatsappPreOnboardingInviteE2E.js",
    "test:whatsapp:e2e:import": "node scripts/runWhatsappImportE2E.js",
    "test:whatsapp:e2e:bill-pay": "node scripts/runWhatsappBillPayE2E.js",
    "test:whatsapp:e2e:planner-writes": "node scripts/runWhatsappPlannerWritesE2E.js",
    "pm2:stop": "pm2 stop all",
    "pm2:logs": "pm2 logs",
    "reset:spreadsheet": "node scripts/resetSpreadsheetData.js",
    "backfill:user-id": "node scripts/backfillUserId.js",
    "seed:known-users": "node scripts/seedKnownUsers.js",
    "finalize:legacy-user-id": "node scripts/finalizeLegacyUserIds.js"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "whatsapp",
    "bot",
    "finance",
    "google-sheets",
    "gemini"
  ],
  "author": "Daniel Santos",
  "license": "ISC",
  "dependencies": {
    "@langchain/langgraph": "^1.4.2",
    "better-sqlite3": "^12.8.0",
    "dotenv": "^16.3.1",
    "ffmpeg-static": "^5.2.0",
    "fluent-ffmpeg": "^2.1.3",
    "googleapis": "^172.0.0",
    "node-cache": "^5.1.2",
    "node-cron": "^4.2.1",
    "qrcode-terminal": "^0.12.0",
    "string-similarity": "^4.0.4",
    "whatsapp-web.js": "github:pedroslopez/whatsapp-web.js#main",
    "winston": "^3.11.0",
    "xlsx": "https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "acorn": "^8.15.0",
    "ajv": "8.17.1",
    "ajv-formats": "3.0.1",
    "nodemon": "^3.0.1",
    "playwright": "^1.60.0",
    "ses": "2.3.0"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=20.0.0"
  }
}
